metadataRaw.title: The Base of the Skull Pain Muscle (How to Release It for INSTANT RELIEF)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly release tightness and tension in muscles that cause the most pain around the base of the skull.

A big contributing factor of upper neck pain and discomfort comes from a build up of stress, tension, and tightness in muscles that can lead to painful strain and inflammation. 

This video will keep it simple by fixing weakness and tightness in the main muscles that cause pain in this area, especially the suboccipital and upper trapezius.

Each exercise works a little differently. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives you the most pain relief. 

As a bonus, all of these exercises can be done at home.

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:55 Suboccipital Release
4:01 Suboccipital Stretch
5:23 Upper Trapezius
7:15 Sternocleidomastoid (SCM)
8:29 Levator Scapulae
9:31 Daily Strengthening Exercise
